name: InterContinental Cartagena de Indias
insider_take: This stunning colonial fortress-turned-luxury hotel sits within the UNESCO World Heritage Old City, where centuries-old cobblestone streets meet Caribbean sophistication.
whats_special: Built within the historic walls of a 17th-century Spanish colonial building, this InterContinental seamlessly blends period architecture with modern luxury. The rooftop pool offers breathtaking views of the Caribbean Sea and the iconic Clock Tower, while the hotel's location puts you steps away from the famous Plaza de Armas and colorful colonial balconies draped in bougainvillea.
pro_tip: Book a room facing the city walls for sunset views, and visit the rooftop bar during golden hour when the ancient fortifications glow against the Caribbean backdrop.
dont_miss: Walking the complete circuit of the ancient city walls at sunrise, exploring the nearby Castillo San Felipe de Barajas fortress (largest Spanish fort in the Americas), and experiencing the vibrant nightlife in the Getsemaní neighborhood just minutes away.
pros: Prime location in historic Cartagena's Old City
Stunning colonial architecture with modern luxury amenities
Exceptional rooftop pool with panoramic city views
cons: Historic building layout may have limited accessibility features
